method.name: GPT-6.1 Terra without reasoning + line ownership with ink on no line and rule pieces, polygon regions

source.note: The source model call is not repeated; its cost and timing are in the source output.

coordinates: Polygon rings are in input-image pixel indices, outer boundary only, largest piece first. Vertex (x, y) is the center of pixel column x and row y, and a region is its closed polygon including boundary pixels. In a corner-based system such as SVG with the image at (0, 0), add 0.5 to both coordinates. model_box is the source result's derived box, unchanged.
